page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Page number top left, running head top right. A marginal note in the left margin beside the line "malo rejuratæ. Tertius ergo Casus est". A catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.l: de rebus ex se illicitis dicta sunt.
Sequuntur quæ ex se non illicitæ, sunt
autem rei licitæ, ut fiat illicita; aut ex
errore personæ jurantis, aut ex effectu
est, cum quis juramento pollicetur se factu-
rum aliquid in se fortassis licitum, quod
tamen ipse putat esse illicitum, aut certè
veretur ne non sit licitum. Ut si quis
ante hæc tempora admittendus ad bene-
vestem sc. lineam, crucis signum ad sa-
id genus alios; quos ipse tamen ex aliquo
osos & Papisticos. Quæritur in hoc casu
quæ sit Obligatio? Pro responsione dico

page.notes: Marginal note "Casus 7." (left) transcribed where it stands. Catchword "tria." read in italics at the bottom right. "fc." read as "sc." (vestem sc. lineam), a likely abbreviation. "rejuratæ" and "superstiti-osos" are hyphenated line-end forms as printed. The left and right page edges show only stains and show-through, which are not transcribed.
